===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{lb|en|translation studies}} The act of [[translate|translating]] something from one language to another by means of a [[machine]], especially a [[computer]].
# {{lb|en|computing|programming}} The production of instructions in a [[computer language]] that are equal in meaning to that in another language.
